summary: Set or clear caller-supplied bits in the global flag dword_8B8E34 based on a2 (nonzero sets, zero clears), returning the resulting combined value.

operations.description: if a2 is nonzero take the set path, otherwise take the clear path
dword_8B8E34 |= a1 (set path: OR the caller bits into the global flag word)
result = a1 | dword_8B8E34 (set path: combined bit mask)
dword_8B8E34 &= ~a1 (clear path: AND out the caller bits from the global flag word)
result = ~a1 (clear path: complement of the caller mask)
return result (combined mask on set path, complement on clear path)
